scope: Known confirmed treasury outbound SOL monitoring contract only

provider_audit.helius: RECOMMENDED: existing explicit-authority JSON-RPC transport, version-aware compact decoder, and ws_cascade websocket capability. Existing deployed ws_cascade configuration has treasury subscription cap 0, so it is not an active treasury-monitoring authority.
provider_audit.helius_webhook: POSSIBLE FUTURE EVENT ROUTE: existing webhook infrastructure exists, but current treasury-address coverage and delivery health are not qualified by this DEV.
provider_audit.solana_rpc_fallback: NOT ELIGIBLE: existing legacy helpers may fall back, whereas DEV-019 requires explicit authority and no fallback/retry.
provider_audit.alchemy: NOT SELECTED: retained integration is for historical account state, not an established bounded outbound-monitoring transport.
provider_audit.birdeye: NOT SELECTED: authoritative paid price provider, not native-SOL transaction lineage acquisition.

monitoring_model.event_route: Future Helius websocket/webhook delivery may mark a treasury RECONCILIATION_DUE; it cannot claim coverage until bounded reconciliation completes.
monitoring_model.reconciliation: Every confirmed treasury remains eligible. HOT every 15 minutes, ACTIVE hourly, DORMANT/RETIRED/UNKNOWN daily; one cursor-bounded getSignaturesForAddress page (<=20) per due treasury, decode all selected signatures before cursor advance.
monitoring_model.failure_recovery: Persist cursor and coverage status. On partial decode, provider limit, rotation, or failure retain the old cursor and mark COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE or PROVIDER_LIMIT_STOP. No negative conclusion and no full-wallet rescan.
monitoring_model.direction_and_decode: Use existing compact native decoder. Index only direct System transfers whose sender is a confirmed treasury and whose balance deltas verify. Decode outer and inner instructions; retain WSOL close events as context, never as direct funding.
monitoring_model.forward_backward_contract: A verified outbound compact record indexes recipient. A later Walkback chain intersects it only when direct verified edges are contiguous, strictly ordered, and amount-compatible. Shared recipients remain ambiguous. Connection exposes review-only funding provenance; operation assignment remains null.

cost_model.assumptions: Measured 83-account activity mix scaled deterministically; one signature request per due reconciliation; zero transaction decodes shown below. Add one getTransaction request for every selected changed signature requiring classification. Existing repository metric schedule charges 10 credits per listed request; live plan pricing was not queried.
cost_model.recovery_overhead: A failed or partial selected page is retried only by an explicitly authorized future bounded recovery policy; this contract does not silently retry.

next_gate: A separate live-acquisition/deployment approval must validate actual Helius websocket or webhook capacity, current configured treasury coverage, durable cursor-store authority, provider budget, runtime deployment gate, and a bounded recovery policy before any monitoring starts.
